findings.observed: The release source gate failed during concurrent activity-log rotation: writers raced on a shared gzip temporary file and the test observed missing rows.
findings.recommendation: Coordinate rotation across Python and Swift writers so concurrent rotations cannot replace or remove each other’s files, while preserving crash recovery and retention.

details.Candidate: Python and Swift rotation now acquire the same persistent per-log lock across archive shifting and gzip. Existing inode locks still protect append and rename. This candidate has not been installed.
